outcomes.outcome: rsyslog and its GnuTLS driver are installed, and rsyslog runs and starts at boot
the node's Puppet CA, certificate and key are copied for rsyslog, byte for byte, and form a valid identity
the user rsyslog drops to (syslog) can read the key, and other users cannot
a stopped rsyslog runs again after the next agent run
a change to the TLS directory restarts rsyslog at the next agent run
a change to a TLS file (a renewed certificate) restarts rsyslog once at the next agent run
on RedHat, a syslog user and group (uid/gid 0) exist for the copied files' ownership

uncovered.why: these checks run on the Ubuntu node, where the syslog account exists already
